calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single landscape 1536 x 1024 architectural visualization for a worldbuilding atlas, no text.
Primary request: Create the matching EXTERIOR arrival view of the canonical building in the reference section. The reference image is an architectural geometry reference, not an edit target; make one new realistic exterior illustration.
Invariants from reference: ONE rectangular long pale-mineral-and-steel megaframe containing exactly THREE huge broad clear-volume world halls stacked vertically, above ONE lower logistics/arrival podium. The three occupied hall volumes have equal overall width and vertical walls aligned into one rectilinear shell. Thick continuous amber technical/service bands separate the halls and form the roof band. A tall DARK GRAPHITE PASSENGER LIFT CORE stands at the LEFT end of the front facade, running from public ground arrival to all three halls. A separate narrower DARK SERVICE/FREIGHT CORE stands at the RIGHT end. Building must read as the same massing as the sectional reference. Small terraced public entry structures are allowed only at the far left beside the main rectangular body. No staggered upper halls or projecting open terraces.
Scene: A believable generous civic arrival square extends across the foreground. The camera is a low three-quarter street approach, only modestly elevated, showing almost all of the building with very large scale but real human-sized foreground groups arriving on foot or using mobility chairs, small trees, a tactile building model and simple benches. A few visitors pause near the shaded entrance at the base of the LEFT passenger core. Whole-building identification is primary, arrival-scale detail secondary.
Facade: Realistic enclosed glazed and pale-panel outer skin, with subtle dim glimpses of each vast hall behind a broad translucent front facade. Thin conventional mullions may divide glazing, but do not introduce extra occupied floors. The amber bands and opposite graphite cores are legible from outside; broad opaque pale roof and side walls. The ground-level facade may show service doors on the right and shaded public arrival on the left. Do not expose it as an open-front dollhouse or reproduce the cutaway.
Style: Beautiful detailed architectural concept rendering, warm late-afternoon daylight, quiet blue sky, pale mineral shell, brushed steel, charcoal cores and amber service floors. An ambitious civic place designed specifically for shared augmented-world inhabitation, cared for and socially inviting. Single full composition, horizontal 3:2.
Constraints: No letters, words, labels, logos, HUD, captions or numbering. No collage. No ordinary office or mall small-floor pattern. No impossible floating structure. Do not invent measured dimensions, solved structural engineering, or brand products.
calls.review: Three-hall geometry and public arrival succeeded. Blue wireframe scenery had been inherited from the conceptual section and needed removal from an ordinary exterior view.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: landscape 1536 x 1024 architectural illustration.
Edit target: the provided exterior illustration. Make ONE targeted correction while preserving the camera, people, sunlight, trees, building geometry, dark left passenger core, dark right service core, exactly three broad stacked halls, amber service bands, arrival plaza, benches and all architectural details.
Remove ALL pale-blue wireframe/holographic landscapes seen behind the three huge glass hall facades. This image must show the ordinary physical exterior seen by unaided eyes: behind the glass, show the same halls' calm pale real interior surfaces, real decks and subtle practical warm lights ONLY. The shared immersive scenery is personal display imagery and must NOT be visible from outside as blue holograms. Also remove the glowing blue effect from the foreground tactile model, making it an ordinary small solid pale physical architecture model on the same table; preserve its scale, location and surrounding people. Keep the upper glazing slightly reflective and the vast three real interior hall volumes readable.
No new elements, no text, no other changes. Single realistic image, no diagrams.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one 1536 x 1024 landscape lived-world concept illustration for a visual worldbook.
Input images: Image 1 is the canonical physical building section and anchors the underlying large clear-volume world hall. Image 2 is the prior paired material/experienced study, used ONLY for the physical vocabulary of warm mineral curved promenade, ochre curved bench, wood-and-dark-metal handrail and luminous cloud-harbor palette. Do NOT copy its three sightseeing figures or dense column grid.
Primary request: Show a specific ongoing tradition in the cloud harbor: a small community gathers every evening to play a welcoming musical phrase when an imagined sailing vessel arrives through the clouds. The reader should feel they could join, listen, or linger.
This is the EXPERIENCED VIEW delivered through a proposed occlusive/passthrough wearable display, not a physical hologram or unaided ordinary room. Everyone participating wears a restrained opaque graphite wraparound visor with a narrow visible solid front, like a light future mixed-reality visor, not clear ordinary spectacles. Keep human faces and smiles legible below visors. No UI.
Camera: eyeheight beside a broad curved warm pale-mineral promenade in the LEFT near-corner of a vast clear-volume world hall, looking across its broad open expanse. A dark graphite portal doorway is on the far LEFT edge behind the gathering, retained as a recognizable threshold but experienced as a dark harbor gate; no structural column forest. A continuous wood-topped dark-metal rail sweeps along the right edge above the apparent cloud sea. An ochre curved bench is along the inner edge of the promenade.
Scene: Foreground and middle ground centered on ONE low oval WOOD TABLE, tangible and comfortably reachable, holding a copper tongue drum and a compact unmarked black-and-wood keyboard. Exactly FIVE clearly featured adults arranged naturally around it: near left a woman in a rust-colored shirt seated on the ochre bench plays the copper drum with two small mallets; center left an older silver-haired person in a sage-green top leans into the small keyboard; right an adult in a navy jacket sits listening in a manual wheelchair, hands resting in lap; beyond table a dark-skinned adult in a cream shirt stands keeping rhythm gently with a hand; farther right near the rail another adult in a mustard top rests a hand on the wooden rail, quietly watching the vessel. Plausible anatomy and scale. People enjoy the shared music without posing for a group photograph. No crowded ensemble of tiny extra instruments.
World beyond: An extraordinary vast cloud harbor surrounds the real path, rail, table and bench. One distinctive elegant pearl sail-vessel approaches in the middle-right distance through layers of luminous clouds, with a few distant airy harbor islands and suspended docks. The sail and rigging are imagined story scenery, not literal levitation infrastructure. Late afternoon pearl-blue and amber light lends intimacy to this gathering against enormous sky depth.
Style: Sophisticated realistic architectural experience concept art, material grain and tactile musical objects sharply legible in foreground, coherent shared light on companions, vast atmospheric depth in distance. One continuous scene, no panels.
Constraints: No text, no numbers, no captions, no logos, no screens or holographic UI, no ordinary transparent glasses, no military elements. Feet and wheelchair are on a real continuous deck, all hand contact meets a tangible surface. Keep the circular table, ochre bench, wood rail, dark left doorway and five people's clothing/layout clear enough to replicate in a matching material/experienced pair.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape 1536 x 1024 paired architectural visualization, exactly TWO EQUAL VERTICAL PANELS with a single thin clean divider, no words.
Input images: Image 1 is the canonical physical building section, used only for the THREE broad stacked clear-volume halls over logistics, dark passenger core at LEFT and dark service core at RIGHT. Image 2 is the NEW harbor music gathering. Preserve its social scene, clothing, objects and contact geometry in BOTH PANELS; this is the living scene to explain.
Primary request: A precise identical-camera pair makes the real supporting architecture and the display-mediated experience of the same continuing music gathering immediately understandable.
BOTH panels lock identical physical placement: broad pale warm-mineral curved promenade with a wood-topped dark metal rail, curved ochre bench around ONE oval wooden table, copper tongue drum and small black-and-wood keyboard. Exactly five adults arranged as in Image 2: rust-shirt woman seated near left playing two mallets on copper drum; silver-haired elder in sage green playing keyboard; cream-shirt dark-skinned adult standing behind table marking time; navy-shirt person in manual wheelchair seated at table right listening; mustard-shirt woman in light trousers standing beyond at rail with one hand resting on it. The same restrained opaque graphite wraparound visors in both panels (future proposed occlusive display, not clear spectacles). The graphite passenger portal doorway stands immediately behind and to the LEFT of the bench, at the left edge. Keep floor, bench, table, instruments, limbs, wheelchair, door and rail MATCHED, same poses, same camera lens, same ground geometry and object positions. Fit the entire small social group comfortably within each panel by placing the camera only slightly farther back than Image 2, not cutting off the wheelchair or foreground bench.
LEFT PANEL is the ORDINARY PHYSICAL WORLD: an inhabited near-left corner of ONE enormously broad open world hall. The graphite passenger-core doorway behind the bench is solid. Past the curved rail there is a vast uninterrupted real hall volume with broad low terrain decks, a gently rising ramp, far perimeter wall and distant right freight/service access door. The high pale hall ceiling has long-span trusses/overhead practical equipment and one amber technical strip along the upper back perimeter. Span is conceptual. Any structural supports are at the extreme perimeter; NO dense column forest, no longitudinal warehouse aisles. All scenery is normal mineral-and-steel physical architecture under warm controlled room lighting. No clouds or blue ghost wireframes, no holograms, no projected fantasy visible. Tactile furniture and instruments stay beautiful and cared for.
RIGHT PANEL is the EXPERIENCED VIEW THROUGH THE PROPOSED DISPLAYS: identical people, floor, wheelchair, bench, oval table, tangible instruments, near-left dark portal doorway and wood rail remain fixed and fully visible. The far enclosing ceiling and hall walls are visually replaced by the same immense warm pearl-blue cloud harbor as Image 2. One pearl sail-vessel approaches beyond the rail in middle-right distance. Floating-looking islands and harbor settlements fill the atmospheric distance. The sky wraps continuously around the actual physical social gathering; it is not a window screen or framed mural.
Style: sophisticated realistic editorial architectural concept illustration. Close careful bodily scale, material textures, pleasing warm light, joy of ongoing communal music. The intended message is one continuing group interaction on real surfaces with two ways of seeing its envelope.
Constraints: exactly two vertical panels, same camera for each, no third panel/inset, no titles or labels, no letters, numbers, arrows, logos or UI. Do not duplicate table/people inside a panel. No unsupported feet or wheelchair. No physical levitation claim. Match tangible spatial anchors across the central divider rather than merely showing two thematically related scenes.
calls.review: The material hall, people and tactile anchors matched well, but output was a portrait frame with stacked panels; corrected in the next call.
